data.title: PTTEP wins two awards at SET Awards 2026, reflecting excellence in innovation and investor relations
data.description: Ms. Kanita Sartwattayu, Chief Executive Officer of PTT Exploration and Production PublicCompany Limited (PTTEP), received two prestigious awards at the SET Awards 2026 from Mr. Asadej Kongsiri, President of the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET). These accolades include the SET Award of Honor: Best Innovative Company, presented to PTTEP for the fifth consecutive year in recognition of its innovative “DigitalX,” which enhances operational efficiency across the entire exploration and production (E&P) value chain, and the Outstanding Investor Relations Awards, recognizing excellence in investor relations among listed companies with a market capitalization exceeding THB 100 billion.

data.title: Three Major Trade Shows to Watch in 2026!
data.description: Grand Master Exhibition Co., Ltd. , in collaboration with the Thailand Convention and Exhibition Bureau (TCEB), the Office of Small and Medium Enterprises Promotion (OSMEP), the Thai Advertising Business Development Association (TABDA), and the Thai Garment Manufacturers Association (TGMA), is gearing up to present three of the year's leading trade shows: Bangkok Ad & Sign Expo 2026, Bangkok Digital Textile Print Expo 2026 , and Bangkok Pack & Label Expo 2026.

data.title: CG Capital Targets Phuket’s Premium Residences Market with 3 Billion Baht
data.description: CG Capital Advisory Co., Ltd. (CG CAPITAL) , a member of the Central Group, is expanding its real estate portfolio into the premium residences segment with the launch of PURITA Phuket Bangtao , its first proprietary residential brand, with a total project value of 3 billion baht. The launch marks a strategic extension of CG Capital’s expertise in luxury property development into the premium residential market, bringing together quality living, considered design and a distinctive location at an attractive price point, while maintaining the design standards and residential experience that underpin its developments.

data.title: iLaw chief seeks dismissal of PM defamation case
data.description: Yingcheep Atchanont, director of the Internet Law Reform Dialogue (iLaw), has urged the Criminal Court to dismiss a defamation case brought against him by Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul.

data.title: Can the Brain Repair Itself After Alcohol? What Science Says About Recovery
data.description: Alcohol is one of the most widely consumed substances in the world, but chronic heavy drinking has a profound and damaging effect on the human body. Over time, alcohol alters communication pathways in the central nervous system, shrinks brain volume, and makes it difficult to concentrate, remember details, or control emotions.

data.title: Patrick Stewart, Star Trek and X-Men actor, dies aged 86
data.description: Patrick Stewart, who brought Shakespearean authority to Captain Picard and Professor X, has died at his Los Angeles home at the age of 86.

data.title: Princess Sirivannavari Blends High Fashion and Nature in Autumn/Winter 2026/27 Collection
data.description: Fresh from Milan, the Thai royal designer unveils 36 looks of hand-built moss, recycled watch parts and bold Thai silks, shaped by treks, jumps and cold peaks

data.title: Inheriting the future of horror
data.description: Around the world, horror is having a major cinematic moment. From low-budget internet phenomena turned studio hits like The Backrooms (2026) to high-concept thrillers like Obsession (2025), chilling subversions of the genre are proving that audiences will still flock to cinemas, if given a reason to step into the dark.

data.title: 'Horrific' Russian drone strike kills 13 at Ukraine train station
data.description: KYIV — A Russian drone slammed into a busy platform at a railway station in Ukraine's Dnipro on Thursday killing at least 13 people in what President Volodymyr Zelensky called a "horrific" attack that demands a response from Kyiv's allies.

data.title: Oil majors reap bumper profits as Mideast war drives prices
data.description: LONDON - Oil and gas giants Shell and TotalEnergies on Thursday reported soaring quarterly net profits as the Middle East war pushed up hydrocarbon prices -- and the cost of living around the world.

data.title: Rains bring relief to haze-weary Indonesian city
data.description: PALANGKARAYA, Indonesia - Residents and firefighters in an Indonesian city long shrouded in a toxic haze brought on by months of wildfires rushed outside dancing and chanting as rain this week brought a welcome respite.

data.title: Israel piles pressure on Arab parties as Netanyahu seeks government
data.description: JERUSALEM — Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc on Thursday piled pressure on Israeli Arab leaders over unproven accusations of foreign funding, in a push to neuter parties that made strong gains after an otherwise indecisive election.

data.title: PM files ‘tea money’ defamation complaints
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has filed police complaints against opposition MP Rukchanok “Ice” Srinork and the owner of the “Godd Dam” Facebook page over the circulation of a fake claim linking him to a 7-million-baht “tea money” payment.

data.title: AWC makes Ruby the Opening Move in a Drive to Lift Asset Values and Earnings
data.description: Rebranding Holiday Inn Express Sathorn is the first step in AWC’s plan to lift rates and returns by pairing its assets with IHG’s global brands

data.title: First look at LV The Place Bangkok’s new concept
data.description: Louis Vuitton unveils the first look at LV The Place Bangkok in its new concept, through an inspiring new chapter of the Art of Travel.

data.title: Thai-Singaporean sex procurement ring busted
data.description: Police have arrested five people — two Singaporeans and three Thais — accused of recruiting Thai women for prostitution in Singapore and advertising their services online.

data.title: ONE Championship: Chatri defends Haggerty over Akimoto knee – ‘There was no foul’
data.description: ONE Championship boss Chatri Sityodtong has defended Jonathan Haggerty’s disputed knee against Hiroki Akimoto, citing slow-motion footage to reject claims of an illegal strike.

data.title: Le Café Louis Vuitton opens its doors
data.description: Complementing the evolution of Visionary Journeys, the culinary experience at LV The Place has opened its doors.

data.title: Suvarnabhumi runway subsidence probed after plane gets stuck
data.description: The Ministry of Transport is investigating runway subsidence at Thailand’s biggest airport, Suvarnabhumi, after the landing gear of a China Airlines plane got stuck in the runway surface.

data.title: Bangkok Post secures website following brief disruption
data.description: The Bangkok Post website experienced a brief technical disruption on Thursday morning after unauthorised content appeared on its homepage and other pages.

data.title: ‘Sin tax’ revenue shake-up draws fire
data.description: Four proposed legal amendments could put about 14 billion baht a year in funding for health promotion, public broadcasting, elderly welfare and sports development at the government's discretion, prompting public opposition to plans to end their automatic share of alcohol and tobacco tax revenue.

data.title: Mbappe and Real face long road to redemption in China
data.description: HONG KONG - Kylian Mbappe, Real Madrid and La Liga have apologised for the superstar striker’s comments about Mao Zedong, but the damage to their reputation in China won’t be easily or quickly repaired, experts say.
